Package io.github.jspinak.brobot.action.internal.execution

Class ActionLifecycle

java.lang.Object
io.github.jspinak.brobot.action.internal.execution.ActionLifecycle
public class ActionLifecycle extends Object
Tracks the temporal execution state of a GUI automation action.

This class maintains timing information and execution counters throughout an action's lifecycle. It serves as a temporal record from action initiation through completion, supporting the framework's ability to enforce time limits, track repetitions, and manage complex action sequences.

Key temporal concepts:

  • Start time: When the action began execution
  • End time: When the action actually completed (may be before allowed time)
  • Allowed end time: Maximum time permitted for action completion
  • Repetitions: Individual action executions within a sequence
  • Sequences: Complete sets of repetitions

This class supports the model-based GUI automation approach by providing precise temporal tracking needed for robust action execution and failure detection.

  • Constructor Details

    • ActionLifecycle

      public ActionLifecycle(LocalDateTime now, double maxWait)
      Constructs a new ActionLifecycle with start time and duration limit.

      Initializes the lifecycle with the current time as the start point and calculates the maximum allowed end time based on the provided wait duration. The wait time is converted from seconds to nanoseconds for precision.

      Parameters:
      now - The timestamp marking the start of action execution
      maxWait - Maximum duration in seconds the action is allowed to run. Must be non-negative. A value of 0 means no time limit.

  • Method Details

    • incrementCompletedRepetitions

      public void incrementCompletedRepetitions()
      Increments the repetition counter by one.

      Called after each successful execution of the action within a sequence. This method is typically invoked by ActionLifecycleManagement to track progress through configured repetition limits.

    • incrementCompletedSequences

      public void incrementCompletedSequences()
      Increments the sequence counter by one.

      Called when a complete sequence of repetitions has finished. This method is typically invoked by ActionExecution after all repetitions in a sequence are complete.

    • getStartTime

      public LocalDateTime getStartTime()
      The timestamp when this action began execution. Used to calculate duration and enforce time limits.

    • getEndTime

      public LocalDateTime getEndTime()
      The actual completion timestamp of the action.

      This records when the action finished execution, which may be before the allowedEndTime if the action completed successfully or failed early. Remains null until the action completes.

    • getAllowedEndTime

      public LocalDateTime getAllowedEndTime()
      The maximum allowed timestamp for action completion.

      Calculated as startTime plus the configured maximum wait time. Actions exceeding this time are terminated to prevent infinite loops or system hangs.

    • getCompletedRepetitions

      public int getCompletedRepetitions()
      Count of individual action executions completed.

      Tracks how many times the core action has been performed within the current sequence. Used to enforce repetition limits and determine when a sequence is complete.

    • getCompletedSequences

      public int getCompletedSequences()
      Count of complete action sequences executed.

      A sequence consists of one or more repetitions. This counter tracks how many full sequences have been completed, supporting complex multi-sequence operations.

    • isPrinted

      public boolean isPrinted()
      Flag indicating whether action details have been logged.

      Prevents duplicate logging of the same action information, ensuring clean output in reports and logs.
